summary: PureCycle Technologies filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a proposed $250M offering of convertible senior notes due 2032, concurrent with a $145M common stock offering. Terms: interest rate, conversion price, redemption features (after July 2029 at 130% of conversion price), and repurchase rights on fundamental change are to be determined. Notes are unsecured, senior to subordinated debt, structurally junior to subsidiary liabilities. Proceeds partly used to repurchase existing Green Convertible Notes. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation event triggered.
